item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We believe commercial deep-sea mining will end battery-metal shortages. By unlocking vast supplies of nickel, cobalt, copper and manganese, we can secure the materials needed to expand battery production and accelerate electrification.

2. Battery-metal shortages do not have to limit our future. We can end them by beginning commercial deep-sea mining and delivering a dependable new supply of the essential minerals battery manufacturers need.

3. We are ready to replace battery-metal scarcity with abundance. Commercial deep-sea mining will strengthen supply chains, support manufacturing and put shortages behind us for good. It is time to move from exploration to production.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 105 words

We believe commercial deep-sea mining will end battery-metal shortages. The ocean floor holds the nickel, cobalt, copper and manganese needed to build batteries at the scale modern life demands. By opening this resource responsibly and moving from exploration to production, we can break the supply bottlenecks that constrain manufacturing, raise costs and slow electrification. We are ready to replace scarcity with abundance, strengthen secure supply chains and give battery makers the dependable flow of essential minerals they need. The choice is clear: begin commercial deep-sea mining, unlock a vast new source of battery metals and put shortages behind us for good. We support action now.
